Giran.name: Giran
Giran.basicInfo:
Giran, the best-known broker in Japan's underworld, who sells introductions, muscle, hideouts and illegal gear to anyone and takes no side. A lean, sharp-dressed man; slicked-back dark hair, a short beard, a dark suit, a cigarette in hand.
Speaking Style: Smooth, unhurried patter about terms and prices; never names one client to another.
Combat Role: Not a fighter; keeps hired muscle and an exit close.
Under Pressure: Smiles, offers a deal and slips out the back.
Giran.hiddenInfo:
Motivation: Money, and being too useful to remove. Concealment: Keeps his records far from the Chinatown restaurant where he meets buyers. Leverage: Debts owed to him; threats to his records. Connections: Kurogiri, buying for the League of Villains, a new client with money and big talk; small-time villains and smugglers across the port. Knowledge: Who is for hire and who owes whom; never who stands behind a client. Thread: Whether he can stay neutral if one client grows big enough to own the trade.
QUIRK: Never shown; contacts are his power.
personality: Cynical: Expects most clients to fail and prices the risk in.
Opportunist: Makes sure a rising villain owes him early.
Neutral: Stays out of every client's feuds.
Speaking style: Smooth patter about terms and prices.
abilities: Introductions: Matches villains to clients; staffs a job in days if the money is right.
Black market: Hideouts, forged IDs and unregistered support gear; quality follows the price.
Fighting style: Never fights; pays, talks or slips away.
Giran.visualDescription: A lean, middle-aged man with slicked-back dark hair, a short dark beard along his jaw, heavy-lidded, calculating dark eyes and lightly tanned skin. He wears a sharp, well-cut dark suit over an open-collared dark shirt, with a lit cigarette between two fingers. Relaxed, knowing half-smile; the look of a businessman who is never in a hurry.
